reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: A lightweight ampoule that helps soothe, hydrate, and brighten the skin. Infused with Centella Asiatica and brightening capsules, it absorbs quickly and leaves the complexion looking healthy, smooth, and radiant. ✨
reviews.zh: 輕盈嘅精華，幫助舒緩、保濕同提亮肌膚。蘊含積雪草同提亮微囊，快速吸收，令膚色睇起嚟健康、平滑、富有光澤。✨

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: I wanted to give this serum a fair shot, it’s nice but if you are looking for very obvious brightening I don’t really recommend. This is more of a product for those people who don’t really have much hyperpigmentation concern and just want a little more glow. If you have stubborn pigmentation this is not the product for you.
reviews.zh: 想公平咁試吓呢支精華，係唔錯嘅，但如果你係想搵明顯提亮嘅效果，我就唔太推薦。呢款更加適合冇乜色斑困擾、只係想要多啲光澤嘅人。如果你有頑固色斑，呢款就唔啱你。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule (100ml) 🌿💧.
The texture is quite sticky and a bit heavy, so I think it’s better to use at night 🌙.
It has small white capsule dots that take a little time to absorb completely, but it feels soothing on the skin once it settles 😊.
Still waiting to see the brightening results, but so far it feels calming and moisturizing 💦💛.
reviews.zh:
一直用緊SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule (100ml) 🌿💧。
質地幾黐笠同有少少厚，所以我覺得夜晚用會好啲 🌙。
有細細粒白色微囊，要少少時間先至完全吸收，不過settle咗之後對皮膚好舒緩 😊。
提亮效果仲等緊睇，但係到目前為止感覺好鎮靜同保濕 💦💛。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: This is really moisturizing and brightening. I use it both in AM and PM. My fresh post acne really brightens more quickly with it. It’s my second time re-purchasing and I would definitely do it again. Also I love how it’s 100ml.
reviews.zh: 呢支真係好保濕同提亮。早晚都用緊。我啱啱生完暗瘡嘅印，搽完之後真係快好多淡咗。已經係第二次回購，一定會再買。而且好鍾意佢100ml嘅容量。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: I have combination and sensitive skin, so I’m always careful when trying new skincare products. At the moment, I’m still testing this product. The packaging is very convenient and easy to use, which I really appreciate. The serum itself has quite a sticky texture, so it takes some time to absorb. I’ll continue using it to see how my skin reacts over time. If you’d like me to come back with an updated review after longer use, feel free to like this post 💙
reviews.zh: 我係混合性敏感肌，所以試新護膚品都會好小心。而家都仲喺度測試緊呢款產品。包裝好方便好用，我真係好欣賞。精華本身質地幾黐笠，所以要啲時間吸收。會繼續用落去睇吓皮膚反應。如果想我用耐啲之後再返嚟更新評價，隨便俾個like呢個post 💙

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: I use it almost for 3 weeks and it’s hard to say anything really accurate. Like that it doesn’t have any odor. The result is cumulative, I mean i haven’t seen any difference for 2 weeks, but now start to see lightening and a skin tone alignment. I think it requires more time and patience. The texture is thick with a little sticky finishing.
reviews.zh: 用咗差唔多3個星期，好難講啲咩好確實嘅嘢。鍾意佢冇任何味道。效果係累積嘅，即係頭2個星期我完全睇唔到分別，但而家開始見到有提亮同膚色均勻咗。我覺得要更多時間同耐性。質地厚身，帶少少黐笠嘅觸感。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text:
I can’t say anything. It is under the test yet.
I have a sensitive combination skin with post acne scars and a little bit of acne.
If you want me to review again this product after a mont, please like my comment that I can come back and remember to give a review of the process.
reviews.zh:
講唔到啲咩。仲喺度測試緊。
我係敏感肌混合性肌，有暗瘡印同少少暗瘡。
如果你想我用多一個月之後再評價呢款產品，請俾個like我嘅comment，等我記得返嚟畀個進程評價。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule 100ml
reviews.text: I love this product. it is not sticky and feels so smooth. my skin becomes more bright and my acne scars are gradually disappearing. before used many niacinamide products but they all not fit me. I am glad this product fits me so good.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款產品。唔黐笠，感覺好滑。皮膚變得更加光澤，暗瘡印都慢慢褪緊。之前用過好多煙酰胺產品都唔啱我，好開心呢款啱我用。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
